title: WASD Look
cue: scene lighting: sky, sun, fog, glow, day and night cycle
summary: A whole scene's lighting in one node: a sky with clouds, a sun with shadows, bounce light, fog, exposure, and glow, set by ten looks, a day clock, or an HDRI sky, and alike on every renderer.
useWhen: Any 3D game, in place of a hand-set WorldEnvironment and DirectionalLight3D, which tend to come out flat or burnt out and differ between desktop and Web builds: days, sunsets, nights, a day that runs, an HDRI sky from Poly Haven, a studio for one model, or a dim room for its lamps.
avoidWhen: A 2D game, or a game whose own lighting already gives the look it wants and was checked in a Web build. Use it or sky3d, not both: both own the sky and sun; sky3d suits desktop only. Fog in one place and lamp halos are wasd-light's, rain and snow wasd-weather's, a film grade wasd-post's.
